_comment: Canonical facts for neilcatton.com. Anything that appears on more than one page belongs here, not retyped into the page. build.mjs resolves the tokens.
name: Neil Catton
jobTitle: Group CTO, Non-Executive Director, and Author
description: Independent technology strategist and author. {{years.Words}} years working where large organisations meet complex technology decisions.
_facts: careerStartYear drives every 'N years in technology' figure on the site. Before this the site said 'thirty-seven years' on twelve pages and 'thirty-nine years' on one. Build recalculates it, so it can never drift again and never goes stale on 1 January.
_substack: One canonical Substack host. neilcatton.substack.com appeared in 43 places and writing.neilcatton.com in 107; both resolve, but split citation splits link equity and confuses entity consolidation.
_predictivePurpose: Amazon links for the book Predictive Purpose, used as {{pp.kindleUK}} etc. on the book page, the books page and the contact page, so the launch-day swap is one edit here. Kindle links go in when pre-order opens; paperback links on launch day (23 October 2026). A link a page uses that is still empty FAILS the build, so no page can ship with a dead Buy button. The tool at predictiveTool is a different thing: the self-assessment.
_sameAs: Person schema sameAs. linkedin is empty because the URL is not referenced anywhere on the site and was not supplied — build omits empty entries rather than guessing one. Add it here and it appears on every page.
_nav: Four groups, plus Search and Book a call. Sectors is the way in for someone arriving with a problem. Native <details>, so the menus work with no script at all; site.js adds Escape and click-away.
_footer: One row of everything else. The four menus already carry the content pages.
